name: zc-care-docs
description: Antora toolchain for the zc-care documentation site. Not part of the Go module.

scripts.docs:theme: rm -rf build/pdf-theme && mkdir -p build/pdf-theme && curl -fsSL -o build/zc-pdf-theme.zip https://github.com/zoolcoder/zc-supplemental-ui/releases/download/v0.3.0/zc-pdf-theme.zip && echo '5f378ca52b404e4edea622447621eb21dd31913e32a0be88388c078ea13cb9a5  build/zc-pdf-theme.zip' | shasum -a 256 -c - && unzip -qo build/zc-pdf-theme.zip -d build/pdf-theme
scripts.docs:local: rm -rf build/pdf-theme && mkdir -p build/pdf-theme && cp ../../Framework/kits/zc-supplemental-ui/pdf/* build/pdf-theme/ && antora --ui-bundle-url ../../Framework/kits/zc-supplemental-ui/build/ui-bundle.zip antora-playbook.yml
